howto.what: 该技能指导 Claude 从事件流构建读取模型和投影，包含投影架构、实时/追赶/持久/内联四种类型，以及幂等性、事务、检查点等最佳实践，并提供详细模板库。
howto.when: 当你实现 CQRS 读取端、创建物化视图或优化事件溯源系统的查询性能时触发。

say.text: 帮我为这个事件流设计一个读取模型
say.note: Claude 会给出投影架构和设计建议。

say.text: 如何从事件流构建物化视图？
say.note: Claude 会讲解步骤和注意事项。

say.text: 我想实现投影的重建，应该注意什么？
say.note: Claude 会提示幂等性、检查点等最佳实践。

howto.what_en: This skill guides Claude on building read models and projections from event streams, covering projection architecture, four projection types, and best practices like idempotency and transactions, with detailed templates.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you implement CQRS read sides, create materialized views, or optimize query performance in event-sourced systems.

say_en.text: Design a read model for this event stream
say_en.note: Claude gives architecture and design advice.

say_en.text: How do I build a materialized view from events?
say_en.note: Claude will explain the steps and key points.

say_en.text: What should I consider when rebuilding projections?
say_en.note: Claude will mention idempotency, checkpoints, etc.
